data.title: Real use case: Softcat builds Copilot adoption through practice
data.summary: A named customer reports role-specific Excel practice and branded PowerPoint guidance as part of its adoption program.

facts.text: Microsoft's Softcat story describes hands-on Excel sessions, reusable prompts and support for branded PowerPoint content. It is a historical customer account, not a new release or a controlled productivity study.

prerequisites: An existing licensed pilot group, a brand template and tasks meaningful to their roles.
steps: Use the reported adoption pattern to choose one bounded Excel or presentation task.
Practice with users on their existing templates and capture a reusable prompt and review checklist.
Measure correctness and actual review effort before expanding the pilot.
data.output: A role-specific adoption pilot with a reusable recipe and explicit success criteria.
validation: Compare output correctness, brand adherence and completion effort against the prior process.
limitations: The story does not establish results for your organization or availability of every current Copilot feature.
